By promoting your work and expanding your influence in the city, fans will come from further afield. Enter a mysterious world of street art in a mysterious city in BRICOLAGE HEADS. Make art quickly and promote it even more quickly so that your opponent doesn't steal your fans. After all, by bringing in fans you can get kick-ass effects. The higher the value, the more fans you can bring in at once — but you cannot concentrate solely on increasing the value because the player who draws the last fan from a town square gains the right to erect their own sign in that square. Not only can you earn points by building a signboard; you can also choose from multiple signboard effects to activate. Discover Board Game Arena Rules summary KIKAI – Bricolage Heads is a two-player strategy game in which players compete to build creations (KIKAI) from recycled parts across six districts. Players earn Victory Points by building components, attracting Fans, gaining Influence, and hosting Exhibitions. Objective The player with the most Victory Points (VP) after four rounds wins the game, unless one player achieves an Instant Media Victory by placing all six of their billboards. Gameplay These rules describe the Standard game. Differences for Advanced Mode are listed at the end. Game Flow The Yellow player begins. Players alternate turns until both have taken the number of turns shown on their Player Board for that round (5 or 6 turns depending on the round). When a round ends, victory points are granted based on a players Renown on the Master’s Board, and the next round begins. The game ends after Round 4 or immediately upon a Media Victory. Turn Structure Each turn, a player: 1) Plays one District Card from their hand , which determines the District in which the player will act. Alternatively, play two identical District Cards together to perform an action in any District. Cards are placed in the current turn column of their Player Board. 2) Performs one of four actions (discussed below) in that District: Build a KIKAI Component Deploy Flyer Droppers Attract Fans Host an Exhibition Optional : discard 1 Megaphone token to play another District Card (or two identical) and perform a second action. 3) Draws one new District Card , either one of the two visible cards or the top card of the deck. Optional : discard any number of Ladder tokens to draw that many additional cards from the top of the deck. End of a Round All District Cards played are collected and reshuffled, then placed beneath the draw pile. On the Master’s Board, each player gains VP according to their Renown position multiplied by the round’s VP multiplier (×4, ×3, or ×2 as indicated). Renown markers are reset to 'Start'. Actions Build a KIKAI Component Build one component (Foot, Body, or Head) in the District matching your played card by paying its Energy cost and gaining Influence (1 for a Foot, 2 for a Body if a Ladder is placed, 3 for a Head if 2 Ladders are placed). A new component of that type is immediately revealed. The first to build a Head in a District, claims its Construction Bonus and applies the immediate VP reward. Deploy Flyer Droppers Deploy Flyer Droppers from your Energy Track onto the streets (white squares) starting from the chosen District, at 2 Energy cost per Flyer Dropper. Deployment must start from or extend your existing network from that District. Networks do not pass through a District. Some Energy-Track spaces and street spaces grant immediate bonuses as indicated. Attract Fans Attract Fans of matching colors to your KIKAI in that District and trigger their Effects, one Fan per component, provided that Fan can reach the District through Flyer Droppers.
